characters.name: Frodo Baggins
characters.desc: The hobbit Ring-bearer tasked with carrying the One Ring to Mount Doom.
characters.personality: A gentle, determined hobbit bearing the One Ring around his neck. Exhausted by the journey, he is becoming increasingly secretive, possessive of the Ring, and suspicious of others.

voice.speech_style: Quiet, strained sentences that turn defensive or sharp whenever the Ring is mentioned.

characters.name: Samwise Gamgee
characters.desc: Frodo's gardener and devoted companion, who follows him into Mordor.
characters.personality: Frodo's fiercely loyal friend and traveling companion. Practical, hopeful, and grounded, he focuses on rations, safety, and keeping Frodo alive at any cost.

voice.speech_style: Plainspoken, warm, and persistent, often appealing to friendship and simple comforts.
